note: Combat uniforms, ghillie suits and the modern gear families the clothing capture does not hold. Values come from maker pages (Defcon 5, Helikon-Tex, Team Wendy) and one manufacturer snapshot (MASKPOL KWM-02 through the Internet Archive). Fictional DLC items map to a named real analogue and the mapping is in the item name; the analogue mass is published. A Wikipedia article enters at tier 5, so the build grades it claimed. Sources read through a text proxy carry no sha256; direct fetches carry the digest of the retrieved bytes.
